facts.fact: 队友圣诞礼物：旅行振动器（客场正好用）
facts.anchor: A travel vibrator, perfect for away games.

facts.fact: 她喝多了，把酒精当吐真剂向Georgia坦白友谊
facts.anchor: This alcohol was beginning to feel more like a truth serum.

facts.fact: 她承认那晚越线：朋友不会想吻、不会跨坐朋友
送机拥抱定性：不像道别更像开始
facts.anchor: His hug had felt meaningful. Less of a goodbye and more of a beginning.

facts.fact: Georgia判词：Carson不是想做朋友，他是like-likes你
facts.anchor: Carson doesn’t want to be your friend. He like-likes you.

facts.fact: 她的不可行清单：目标/她的事业/他的事业/异地/哥哥
facts.anchor: My goals. My career. His career. The distance. My brother.

facts.fact: Georgia的safe理论：因为笃定不会成真才敢喜欢
facts.anchor: “Maybe it feels ‘safe’ to like Carson because you’re convinced it can never amount to anything.”

facts.fact: Georgia自白：过去专挑不会选她的人守心，现在不玩了
facts.anchor: I was guarding my heart by picking someone who would never choose me. But I’m done with that.

facts.fact: Georgia警告：别让他觉得你以他为耻
facts.anchor: don’t let him feel like you’re embarrassed to be associated with him. Because that’s the worst.

facts.fact: 她想起球衣叮嘱，愧意上头
facts.anchor: I hated the idea that I’d made Carson feel like I was ashamed of him or our friendship

facts.fact: LA布局：Georgia公寓与Carson同楼（老板Atlas名下折扣租）
facts.anchor: a lot of the guys from the team lived there at a discounted rent. Including Carson.

facts.fact: Carson拿game puck：Gabe点名，最后几分钟的进球源自Logan的建议
facts.anchor: A shot I’d made, thanks to advice from Logan.

facts.fact: 她五字短信击中他：连父母都不曾这样肯定过他
facts.anchor: my parents had never uplifted me the way Logan did. And with her, it was effortless.

facts.fact: 结尾：对Boone承认“还挂念着KT”——半真话
facts.anchor: I was so sick of keeping this secret. So, I admitted the truth. Well…part of it.
